title: Over 7,000 hectares of Tasik Bera Permanent Forest Reserve illegally cleared for crops
desc: KUANTAN: Over 7,000 hectares of the Tasik Bera Permanent Forest Reserve (HSK) are suspected to have been illegally cleared for commercial crops such as oil palm and rubber.

title: Fiji ravaged by sharp surge in HIV cases
desc: The government said in a statement posted on Facebook that 2,016 people were diagnosed with HIV in 2025 and estimated that one in 60 adults was living with the disease.

title: Premier Eby will speak to local politicians amid snap election speculation
